claims.statement: Tom Allen's fight with Joe Goss at Walton, Kentucky was taken from him, according to a Philadelphia correspondent, because Goss's backers robbed him of it.
claims.excerpt: robbed Tom Allen out of the fight he had with him at Walton, Ky., and so had obtained the title for him

fights.excerpt: robbed Tom Allen out of the fight he had with him at Walton, Ky., and so had obtained the title for him
fights.notes: Year not printed in this text; the hint's 1876 is not supported and is dropped. Outcome not stated; the paper says Allen was robbed of the fight.

notes: Only one mention of Allen; the rest of the page is about other fighters.
